cohort: The study participants included 800 primiparous women from Tabriz health centers who had experienced a vaginal birth, alongside a subset of 17 for qualitative interviews and maternal health experts for a Delphi study.
finding: Factors such as lack of physical exercise during pregnancy, limited pain relief, fear of childbirth, lack of skin-to-skin contact, and inability to initiate early breastfeeding significantly increased the probability of a negative childbirth experience among primiparous women.
cross-section timing: Data was collected after women had experienced vaginal birth.
